# treasury_mandates

Treasury mandates records in Operations Desk. Product articles define their operational scope.

Read this collection using `search_records(resource="treasury_mandates", filters={}, cursor=0, limit=20)` or `get_record(resource="treasury_mandates", record_id="<returned id>")`.

**Filters:** exact scalar equality; in, contains, gte and lte operator objects on supported top-level fields. See DB-query-syntax for type and null behavior.

Search returns selected summary fields, so omission from a summary is not proof of absence from the complete record. Read detail before interpreting an optional field. Fields depend on the record type and processing stage; null and absent fields are not zero amounts. Types below describe public record shapes, rather than mandatory properties on every row.

## Fields

| Field | Observed public types | Search use | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `beneficiaries` | array | Top-level filter | Beneficiaries: list of the named business attributes or references; inspect all entries relevant to the record. |
| `business_area` | string | Top-level filter | Business area: public attribute of this record type. The associated service article defines its operational use. |
| `commercial_reference` | string | Top-level filter | Reference supplied by a commercial source; use the source and period when matching evidence. |
| `effective_minute` | integer | Top-level filter | Effective minute: logical minute or duration, as indicated by the field name; compare with get_clock and the applicable event/validity terms. |
| `executor_id` | string | Top-level filter | Executor id: opaque identifier reference. Its target depends on the containing record/operation; do not infer a collection merely by pluralizing the field name. Explicit joins are listed separately. |
| `executor_name` | string | Top-level filter | Executor name: public attribute of this record type. The associated service article defines its operational use. |
| `id` | string | Top-level filter | Opaque record key used by get_record; obtain it from returned records or explicit references. It is not an amount, date or proof of business identity. |
| `limit_minor` | integer | Top-level filter | Limit amount, in integer minor units of the applicable currency. Inspect this record type and its source/receipt to distinguish declared values from actual movements. |
| `payer_entity` | string | Top-level filter | Payer entity: public attribute of this record type. The associated service article defines its operational use. |
| `purposes` | array | Top-level filter | Purposes: list of the named business attributes or references; inspect all entries relevant to the record. |
| `review_delay` | integer | Top-level filter | Review delay: public attribute of this record type. The associated service article defines its operational use. |
| `scope` | string | Top-level filter | Access namespace for the record. It is not a customer name or a universal case_id. |
| `status` | string | Top-level filter | Current state of this particular object. A proposal or submission state is distinct from a posted payment or completed review. Public values represented here: `DRAFT`, `EFFECTIVE`. This list describes the documented records, not an input-validation enum. |
| `valid_from` | integer | Top-level filter | Valid from: public attribute of this record type. The associated service article defines its operational use. |
| `valid_until` | integer | Top-level filter | Valid until: public attribute of this record type. The associated service article defines its operational use. |
| `version` | integer | Top-level filter | Version of the underlying record or evidence, not the benchmark release version. |
